transcript: "You should keep a record of every purchase. You shouldn't lend more than you can afford to lose. You'd better start small — three months of pocket money is enough to learn the habit."

label: Text 2
transcript: "Eli started a small green notebook. By month four he could see the shape of his spending: half on food outside the home, a quarter on small things he didn't remember buying. He decided to cut the small things."
